name: Exindium Alt Text Manager
author: exindium

sections.description:
Exindium Alt Text Manager provides a fast and practical way to review and manage image alt text across your WordPress media library.

Instead of opening individual media attachment pages, you can quickly identify images with missing alt text, review existing alt text, edit values directly from the dashboard, and use filename-based tools when appropriate.

The plugin is designed around a simple workflow: identify what needs attention, make the necessary changes, and keep track of your media library’s alt text coverage.

Alt Text Coverage Overview

The Overview provides a clear snapshot of your media library, including total images, images missing alt text, and current alt text coverage.

From there, you can quickly move to images that need attention or use the available bulk tools.

Review and Edit Alt Text

Separate “Missing Alt Text” and “Alt Text Present” views make it easy to focus on the images you need.

Alt text can be edited and saved directly from the plugin dashboard without opening individual attachment pages.

Filename-Based Alt Text Tools

Image filenames can be used as a convenient starting point when appropriate.

Choose a filename cleanup style and use it when copying filenames manually, processing multiple selected images, generating missing alt text through Bulk Tools, or optionally adding filename-based alt text to new uploads.

Filename-generated text is intended as a practical fallback or starting point. Descriptive alt text written with the image’s actual context in mind is recommended whenever possible.

Bulk Tools

Bulk Tools provides a guided workflow for generating filename-based alt text for images that are currently missing it.

Scan your media library to identify missing alt text, review your selected filename formatting style, and start processing when ready.

Images are processed in controlled batches with progress tracking and pause/resume controls. Existing alt text is preserved and is not overwritten by the bulk operation.

Built for the WordPress Admin

Exindium Alt Text Manager uses vanilla JavaScript, native WordPress functionality, paginated AJAX requests, and cached library statistics to keep the dashboard responsive.

Plugin scripts and styles are only loaded in the WordPress admin area. No plugin assets are added to the public-facing frontend.

Plugin Website

Learn more about Exindium Alt Text Manager and find additional plugin information on the official Exindium website.

Features

  • Alt Text Coverage Overview: View total images, images missing alt text, and your current alt text coverage from a dedicated Overview.
  • Missing Alt Text View: Quickly find images in your media library that currently have no alt text.
  • Alt Text Present View: Review and edit alt text that is already assigned to images.
  • Inline Editing: Edit and save alt text directly from the plugin dashboard without opening individual media attachment pages.
  • Manual Bulk Editing: Select multiple images on the current page and use the ‘Auto-fill from Filename’ bulk action to instantly generate and save cleaned alt text for the batch.
  • Bulk Tools: Scan your media library for missing alt text, preview your selected filename formatting style, and generate alt text in controlled batches with progress tracking and pause/resume support.
  • Existing Alt Text Protection: Bulk filename generation and automatic upload fallbacks do not overwrite existing alt text.
  • Filename Cleanup Styles: Choose between Keep Filename Formatting, Clean Spaces & Caps, and Clean & Strip Numbers.
  • Automatic Alt Text for New Uploads: Optionally use cleaned filenames as alt text when newly uploaded images do not already contain alt text.
  • Full-Size Image Preview: Open an image’s full-size version in a new tab for additional context while reviewing alt text.
  • On-Demand Statistics Refresh: Instantly clear the cache and sync your media library statistics with one click using the Refresh Statistics button.
  • Paginated AJAX Loading: Work with the media library without loading every image into the dashboard at once.
  • Multilingual Compatible: Works with WPML Media Translation and Polylang Media, respecting the selected admin language for translated media and language-aware library statistics.
  • No Frontend Assets: Plugin scripts and styles are limited to the WordPress admin dashboard and are not enqueued on the public-facing frontend.
  • Accessible Admin UI: Includes ARIA labels, keyboard-friendly controls, visible focus states, and accessible navigation semantics.
  • Lightweight: Built with vanilla JavaScript and native WordPress functionality, with no jQuery dependency.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the exindium-alt-text-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open “Alt Text Manager” from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Review the Overview or open the “Missing Alt Text” tab to begin managing your media library.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin slow down my website’s frontend?

No. Exindium Alt Text Manager only loads its scripts and styles inside its WordPress admin dashboard.

It does not enqueue plugin assets on the public-facing frontend, so using the plugin does not add its JavaScript or CSS to visitor-facing pages.

Does it work with large media libraries?

The plugin is designed to avoid loading the entire media library into the dashboard at once. Image lists use paginated AJAX requests, while library statistics are cached for 24 hours to reduce repeated database queries.

You can manually sync these cached statistics at any time using the ‘Refresh Statistics’ button on the Overview tab. Bulk Tools also processes missing alt text in batches rather than attempting to process the entire library in a single request.

Actual performance can still depend on your hosting environment and the size of your media library.

What are Bulk Tools?

Bulk Tools provides a guided way to generate filename-based alt text for images that are currently missing it.

Start by scanning your media library to identify images without alt text. Review your selected filename cleanup style and begin processing when ready.

Images are processed in controlled batches, with progress tracking and the ability to pause and resume the operation. Existing alt text is preserved throughout the process.

The scan uses the current media library state rather than relying on cached Overview statistics.

Will Bulk Tools overwrite existing alt text?

No. Bulk Tools are intended for images that are currently missing alt text.

If an image already has alt text, the existing value is preserved rather than overwritten by the filename-based bulk operation.

What happens if alt text changes while a bulk operation is paused?

When a saved bulk operation is resumed, the plugin reconciles the operation with the current media library state.

Images that no longer require alt text are not overwritten, and the operation continues with images that still need to be processed.

How does Automatic Alt Text work?

Automatic Alt Text is an optional setting for new image uploads.

When enabled, if a newly uploaded image does not already contain alt text, the plugin uses the image filename and formats it according to your selected cleanup style.

It does not replace existing alt text.

What filename cleanup options are available?

The plugin provides three filename cleanup styles:

  • Keep Filename Formatting: Keeps the stored filename formatting while removing the file extension and WordPress-generated final -scaled suffix.
  • Clean Spaces & Caps: Converts dots, underscores, and hyphens into spaces and capitalizes words.
  • Clean & Strip Numbers: Applies the clean formatting above and also removes standalone numeric values while preserving numbers that are part of words, such as PS4, iPhone18, or similar filenames.

Does the ‘Auto-fill from Filename’ bulk action save immediately?

Yes. When you select multiple images and apply the ‘Auto-fill from Filename’ bulk action, the plugin instantly generates the cleaned alt text and saves it to the database in one click. If you prefer to review text before saving, use the inline ‘Copy Filename’ icon next to individual images instead.

Should I use filenames instead of writing descriptive alt text?

Filename-based alt text is intended as a practical fallback or starting point.

When an image conveys meaningful content, alt text written specifically for the image and its context will generally be more useful than text derived only from its filename.

The plugin keeps filename generation optional so you can choose the appropriate workflow for each image.

Can I review images that already have alt text?

Yes. Open the “Alt Text Present” tab to review and edit images that already have alt text assigned.

Can I preview the full image while writing alt text?

Yes. Image thumbnails can be opened in their full-size version in a new browser tab, providing additional visual context while reviewing or writing alt text.

Does it work with WPML or Polylang?

Yes. Exindium Alt Text Manager supports media libraries using WPML Media Translation and Polylang Media.

A multilingual plugin is not required to use Exindium Alt Text Manager. When multilingual media functionality is available, the plugin follows the selected admin language and allows alt text to be managed independently for translated media.

The Overview statistics also follow the selected language, including combined media library statistics when viewing all languages.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Fixed a WPML language-switching issue when refreshing Overview statistics.
  • Fixed missing translations for the image selection counter.

1.1.0

  • Redesigned Bulk Tools with a clearer workflow, improved scan results, safety indicators, and filename formatting preview.
  • Improved bulk processing controls, progress tracking, and pause/resume feedback.
  • Improved error handling and status notifications for bulk processing, including network and server interruptions.
  • Unified filename formatting across manual editing, table bulk actions, and Bulk Tools for more consistent results.
  • Improved filename capitalization and cleanup consistency across JavaScript and PHP processing.
  • Fixed inconsistent filename formatting between the image tables and Bulk Tools.
  • Fixed capability handling for manual alt text editing and selected-image bulk actions when access is granted through the exatm_minimum_capability filter.
  • Improved multilingual handling and language-aware bulk processing with WPML Media Translation and Polylang Media.
  • Refined the Bulk Tools interface, responsive layout, and WordPress admin spinner alignment.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
